description:
COACTUPC's US phone area-code lookup on a post-fetch REENTER turn, carrying a HIT and a MISS in one interaction - the case that owns the CSLKPCDY phone table and the forward-jump shape of 1260-EDIT-US-PHONE-NUM. THE TABLE, AND THE DISTINCTION THAT DECIDES EVERY EXPECTED VALUE BELOW. COPY CSLKPCDY at app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:602 - COACTUPC is that copybook's only consumer - brings in not one table but three independent 88-level lists over a single PIC XXX item, WS-US-PHONE-AREA-CODE-TO-EDIT at app/cpy/CSLKPCDY.cpy:24: VALID-PHONE-AREA-CODE, 490 literals at :30-520; VALID-GENERAL-PURP-CODE, 410 literals at :521-930; and VALID-EASY-RECOG-AREA-CODE, 80 literals at :931-1010. The same copybook then declares two more lookups that are not phone lookups at all - US-STATE-CODE-TO-EDIT at :1012 with 56 state codes, and US-STATE-ZIPCODE-TO-EDIT at :1071 with 240 state-plus-first-two-of-zip combinations. EDIT-AREA-CODE tests VALID-GENERAL-PURP-CODE and nothing else: :2296-2298 MOVEs FUNCTION TRIM (WS-EDIT-US-PHONE-NUMA) into WS-US-PHONE-AREA-CODE-TO-EDIT and then asks IF VALID-GENERAL-PURP-CODE. The 490-code superset and the 80-code easy-recognition subset are declared and never referenced by this edit, so membership for this case was re-derived from the :521-930 range ALONE - not from the :30-520 list, and not from any secondary summary. On that 410-literal set '908' IS a member and '373' is NOT. (Both sets happen to agree about these two, because the 410 codes are a proper subset of the 490; the point is which list the program asks, and it asks the 410.) THE HIT AND THE MISS ARE BOTH THE FIXTURE'S OWN DATA. Customer 000000001 of app/data/ASCII/custdata.txt carries CUST-PHONE-NUM-1 '(908)119-8310  ' at bytes 250-264 and CUST-PHONE-NUM-2 '(373)693-8684  ' at bytes 265-279 of its 500-byte CVCUS01Y record - thirteen characters of (NNN)NNN-NNNN followed by two pad spaces in a PIC X(15) span. Area code 908 passes and area code 373 fails, in the same turn, with no invented input whatsoever: the seeded production data fails the program's own edit. That is not a contrived case, it is the norm here - across the 50 customers, 24 phone-1 area codes are in the 410-set and 26 are not, and 12 rows are a phone-1 hit paired with a phone-2 miss. Customer 000000018, whose two area codes 303 and 520 are both members, is the all-pass control and belongs to a different case. Practice B5 requires this expectation to ENCODE the seed's failure rather than avoid it. THE PARTS ARE FED SEPARATELY, WHICH IS HOW THE PROGRAM RECEIVES THEM. The screen supplies six items - ACSPH1AI PIC X(3), ACSPH1BI PIC X(3) and ACSPH1CI PIC X(4) at app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY:264, :270 and :276, and ACSPH2AI, ACSPH2BI, ACSPH2CI at :288, :294 and :300 - so mapFields carries 908 / 119 / 8310 and 373 / 693 / 8684 and never the assembled string. 1100-RECEIVE-MAP MOVEs each part straight into ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-1A/-1B/-1C at :1357-1376 and -2A/-2B/-2C at :1378-1397, which are items of the X(15) REDEFINES at :811-829 whose bytes 1, 5, 9 and 14-15 are FILLER. Those FILLERs are never assigned by receive-map, so after INITIALIZE ACUP-NEW-DETAILS at :1047 they hold SPACES and the value MOVEd into WS-EDIT-US-PHONE-NUM at :1633 and :1641 is ' 908 119 8310  ' rather than the record's parenthesised form - the three parts still sit at (2:3), (6:3) and (10:4), which is all the edit reads. The parenthesised form is reassembled only on the write path, by 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING, which this turn never reaches. THE PATH. EIBCALEN is the full 1033 bytes COMMON-RETURN :1010-1018 returns - 160 for CARDDEMO-COMMAREA plus 873 for WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA - and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is spaces rather than COMEN01C, so both disjuncts of the commarea gate at :880-882 are false and the ELSE at :887-892 restores both areas untouched. This is the turn immediately after case04: the carried CDEMO- fields ARE case04's expectedResponse.navigation, ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION arrives as 'S' (ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS, :659) and ACUP-OLD-DETAILS holds exactly the snapshot 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA :3805-3883 left from these same four fixture rows - ACUP-OLD-ACCT-ID-X 00000000001, ACUP-OLD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, and at scale exactly 2 ACUP-OLD-CURR-BAL-N 194.00, -CREDIT-LIMIT-N 2020.00, -CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT-N 1020.00, -CURR-CYC-CREDIT-N 0.00 and -CURR-CYC-DEBIT-N 0.00, with the four compact eight-byte dates 20141120, 20250520, 20250520 and 19610608 and ACUP-OLD-GROUP-ID at ten spaces. AID DFHENTER is PFK-VALID at :906-912. The order-sensitive EVALUATE TRUE at :921 lands on WHEN OTHER at :996 - PFK03 no, (ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED AND CDEMO-PGM-ENTER) no because the details ARE fetched and the context is REENTER, the LIT-MENUPGM arm no, OKAYED-AND-DONE and CHANGES-FAILED no - so 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION and 3000-SEND-MAP all run and the turn leaves by the forward-only GO TO COMMON-RETURN at :1003. REACHING THE FIELD EDITS COSTS EXACTLY ONE CHANGED FIELD, AND IT IS NOT A FREE CHOICE. 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS :1433-1449 does not take the search-key shortcut this time, so :1452-1457 SETs FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA, FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER, FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID, FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER and FLG-CUSTFILTER-ISVALID and :1460-1468 performs 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW, whose NO-CHANGES-FOUND result would GO TO the exit at :1467 and edit nothing at all. The one field changed here is ACSTFCOI, from the fixture's 274 to 700, and the reason is arithmetic on the program's own ordering rather than convenience. CUST-FICO-CREDIT-SCORE is 274 in custdata.txt, FICO-RANGE-IS-VALID is VALUES 300 THROUGH 850 at :848-849, and the FICO edit runs at :1545-1556 - BEFORE the phone edits at :1632-1646. Every message write in this program is wrapped in IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF, so had 274 been echoed back the FIRST message would have been 'FICO Score: should be between 300 and 850' from :2520-2527 and the area-code message this case exists to pin would have been suppressed entirely. Changing that one field therefore does two necessary things at once: it makes 1205 report CHANGE-HAS-OCCURRED unambiguously, and it clears the only earlier edit the fixture fails. It also makes the case independent of a subtler quirk that would have detected a change anyway - AADDGRPI arrives as ten spaces, :1213-1218 turns SPACES into LOW-VALUES, and comparing that against ACUP-OLD-GROUP-ID's ten spaces through FUNCTION TRIM at :1697-1700 can never be equal. Every other one of the 43 received items is the painted echo of case04's screen, byte for byte. EVERY EDIT AHEAD OF THE PHONES WAS CHECKED, NOT ASSUMED, BECAUSE FIRST-MESSAGE-WINS MAKES ORDER DECISIVE. Account Status 'Y' satisfies FLG-ACCT-STATUS-ISVALID VALUES 'Y','N' through 1220-EDIT-YESNO. The four dates 20141120, 20250520, 20250520 and 19610608 clear EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD (app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy:18-331 - century 19 or 20 only, month 1 through 12, day 1 through 31, the 31-day, February-30 and leap-year combination checks, then EDIT-DATE-LE which CALLs CSUTLDTC and accepts WS-SEVERITY-N = 0), and the date of birth also clears EDIT-DATE-OF-BIRTH :341-368 because 1961-06-08 precedes the pinned 2022-07-19. The five monetary items clear 1250-EDIT-SIGNED-9V2 :2180-2223, which tests FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL-C on the raw X(15) screen text held in ALPHA-VARS-FOR-DATA-EDITING :411-416 - '+      2,020.00', '+      1,020.00', '+        194.00' and '+           .00' twice, each of which matches NUMVAL-C's format of an optional sign, optional spaces, optional currency sign, and digits with comma separators or a bare fractional part. That round trip has to validate for the program to work at all: 3203's IF FLG-CRED-LIMIT-ISVALID branch at :2874-2876 re-renders through the same WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F edit mask it painted with, and would be unreachable otherwise. SSN 020 / 97 / 3888 clears 1265-EDIT-US-SSN :2431-2488 including INVALID-SSN-PART1 (0, 666 and 900 through 999 - 020 is none of them). FICO 700 clears 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD and then 1275. Immanuel, Madeline and Kessler clear 1225 and 1235; address line 1 clears 1215-EDIT-MANDATORY, which only requires non-blank; Altenwerthshire and USA clear 1225; NC clears 1225 and then 1270-EDIT-US-STATE-CD; 12546 clears 1245; phone 1's 908, 119 and 8310 clear all three stages; 0053581756 clears 1245; and 'Y' clears 1220. Address line 2 has NO edit at all - :1613-1614 comments the variable name out - so WS-EDIT-ADDRESS-LINE-2-FLGS keeps the space INITIALIZE WS-MISC-STORAGE :866-868 left it, which is neither its NOT-OK '0' nor its BLANK 'B'. THE THREE STAGES ARE FORWARD-JUMP GUARDED BLOCKS, AND THE CONSEQUENCE IS ASSERTED (gate G30). 1260-EDIT-US-PHONE-NUM :2225-2429 opens by SETting WS-EDIT-US-PHONE-IS-INVALID at :2232, which moves '000' into the three-byte WS-EDIT-US-PHONE-NUM-FLGS group and so starts all three parts at NOT-OK, then takes the not-mandatory shortcut at :2234-2244 only when all parts are blank. EDIT-AREA-CODE :2246 has four GO TO EDIT-US-PHONE-PREFIX exits - blank at :2259, non-numeric at :2277, zero at :2291 and not-in-the-410-set at :2311 - and SETs FLG-EDIT-US-PHONEA-ISVALID at :2314 only if none fired. EDIT-US-PHONE-PREFIX :2316 has three forward exits into EDIT-US-PHONE-LINENUM (:2330, :2348, :2362) and EDIT-US-PHONE-LINENUM :2370 three into EDIT-US-PHONE-EXIT (:2383, :2401, :2415). Every jump is FORWARD, so a rejected area code does NOT stop the later stages - and this case proves it: phone 2's area code is rejected at :2311 and its prefix 693 and line number 8684 are still edited and still declared valid at :2367 and :2421. A translation that returned early from the phone edit would produce the same message and the wrong flags, which is exactly the difference this case is shaped to catch. Each stage owns its own triple, ISVALID at LOW-VALUES, NOT-OK at '0' and BLANK at 'B' (:101-115), and :1637-1638 and :1645-1646 MOVE the whole triple into WS-EDIT-PHONE-NUM-1-FLGS and WS-EDIT-PHONE-NUM-2-FLGS, whose 88s are FLG-PHONE-NUM-1A/1B/1C and 2A/2B/2C at :315-344. The resulting state, which the attribute plane below is the observable projection of, is: phone 1 all three ISVALID at LOW-VALUES; phone 2 FLG-PHONE-NUM-2A-NOT-OK at '0' with 2B and 2C ISVALID at LOW-VALUES. THE MESSAGE IS COMPOSED, NOT PARAPHRASED, AND THERE IS EXACTLY ONE. :1640 MOVEs 'Phone Number 2' into WS-EDIT-VARIABLE-NAME PIC X(25) and the rejection at :2303-2310 STRINGs FUNCTION TRIM(WS-EDIT-VARIABLE-NAME) against the literal ': Not valid North America general purpose area code' taken verbatim from :2306 - 14 characters plus 51 gives the 65-character 'Phone Number 2: Not valid North America general purpose area code'. STRING does not blank the rest of its receiver, but :876 SET WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF already left WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at spaces, so the field is the message plus ten spaces, and 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG :2981 MOVEs it into ERRMSGO PIC X(78) (COACTUP.CPY:650) as the message plus thirteen. Phone 1 produces no message because nothing about it fails; phone 2's is the first message any edit on this turn writes, and the IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF guard on every later write means it is also the last. THE SEED FAILS A SECOND EDIT TOO, AND THAT IS PRESERVED RATHER THAN PAPERED OVER (practice B5). 1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD :2536-2556 is a cross-field edit performed at :1665-1669 because both FLG-STATE-ISVALID and FLG-ZIPCODE-ISVALID hold; it STRINGs the state code against the first two zip digits and asks IF VALID-US-STATE-ZIP-CD2-COMBO. Customer 000000001 is NC with zip 12546, so the probe is 'NC12', which is not among the 240 combinations - NC27 and NC28 are the North Carolina entries - and INPUT-ERROR, FLG-STATE-NOT-OK and FLG-ZIPCODE-NOT-OK are all SET. This is a property of the fixture and not of this case: only 2 of the 50 customers carry a state-and-zip pair the copybook accepts, and neither is one of the 12 phone hit-and-miss rows, so no choice of seed row avoids it and inventing a zip code would be the fabrication practice B5 forbids. It has two visible consequences, both asserted. The message is NOT one of them - 1280 runs AFTER 1260, finds WS-RETURN-MSG already occupied and writes nothing, which is first-message-wins demonstrated across two different paragraphs rather than asserted as a slogan. What it does change is the red fields and, decisively, the cursor. THE SCREEN IS PAINTED FROM WHAT THE USER TYPED, NOT FROM THE FETCHED COPY. :1470 SETs ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK ('E') before the field edits, and :1671-1675 leaves it there because INPUT-ERROR is on. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION :2563-2641 is order-sensitive and lands on WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK at :2596, which is CONTINUE - so NOTHING IS READ on this turn. 9000-READ-ACCT lives only in the first two arms at :2568-2580, so the three reads of case04 do not happen again and the account, customer and cross-reference values on the screen come from ACUP-NEW-DETAILS and ACUP-OLD-DETAILS in the carried area, not from a repository. 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS :2698-2726 takes the ELSE because the context is REENTER, MOVEs CC-ACCT-ID into ACCTSIDO at :2707 because CC-ACCT-ID-N is not zero, and its EVALUATE at :2710-2724 lands on WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-MADE at :2718 - 'E' is in that condition's VALUES 'E','N','C','L','F' at :660-662 - so 3203-SHOW-UPDATED-VALUES :2870-2949 paints the screen and 3202-SHOW-ORIGINAL-VALUES, which case04 used, is never performed. Because the input was the echo, 51 of the 54 sent items come out identical to case04's and that identity is the assertion. Exactly three differ, each for a reason the source states. ACSTFCOO is 700 because :2926 moves ACUP-NEW-CUST-FICO-SCORE-X. AADDGRPO is LOW-VALUES rather than ten spaces because :2921 moves ACUP-NEW-GROUP-ID, which :1215 set to LOW-VALUES when the received field was blank - a difference invisible on a terminal and impossible to miss in a byte comparison. And ERRMSGO now carries the composed rejection instead of 78 spaces, which 3250 writes rather than 3203. INFOMSGO is unchanged at 'Update account details presented above.' padded to 45, because 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG :2957-2977 is also order-sensitive and its WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK arm at :2964 SETs the same PROMPT-FOR-CHANGES that case04's ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS arm did. FKEYSO, FKEY05O and FKEY12O are the mapset's own INITIAL text at app/bms/COACTUP.bms:493-507 and are never assigned by the program. THE ATTRIBUTE PLANE IS THE OTHER HALF OF THE ERROR-HIGHLIGHT MATRIX (gate G38). 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS :2986 does not leave early: the guard at :3186-3189 exits for ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK or FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and none holds, so all 39 CSSETATY expansions from :3208 run. Each is IF (FLG-x-NOT-OK OR FLG-x-BLANK) AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, MOVE DFHRED to the colour item and, only when the flag is BLANK, MOVE '*' over the value (app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy:18-27). The context IS REENTER, so the guard is satisfied and exactly three fields turn red - ACSPH2AC from FLG-PHONE-NUM-2A-NOT-OK, and ACSSTTEC and ACSZIPCC from the cross-field edit - while ACSPH1AC, ACSPH1BC, ACSPH1CC, ACSPH2BC and ACSPH2CC stay at the default DFHDFCOL that MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CACTUPAO at :2669 left. No '*' overlay is written anywhere, because not one flag is at its BLANK value: every failure here is a rejected value, not a missing one. ACCTSIDC also stays default - :3171 needs CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET to equal the card-list mapset and it is spaces, and :3176-3184 need the account filter to be NOT-OK or BLANK and it is ISVALID. INFOMSGH is bright DFHBMASB because 3390 :3567-3571 finds WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE false, and FKEY12H is bright too - which is the one attribute this case has that case04 does not, because :3573-3576 needs ACUP-CHANGES-MADE AND NOT ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE and 'E' satisfies both. FKEY05H stays hidden at DFHDFHI because :3578-3581 needs PROMPT-FOR-CONFIRMATION and the information line holds the change prompt. The xxxA items 3310-PROTECT-ALL-ATTRS :3441-3496 and 3320-UNPROTECT-FEW-ATTRS :3500-3561 write are deliberately not declared: they belong to the input redefine CACTUPAI, not to the sent CACTUPAO, and neither paragraph writes a single CACTUPAO item. THE CURSOR GOES TO THE STATE FIELD, NOT TO A PHONE FIELD, AND THAT IS THE POINT OF PINNING IT. The cursor EVALUATE at :3009-3167 is a second order-sensitive chain over the same flags, and its order is screen position rather than edit sequence. FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA at :3010 is false - :1452 SET it, but 3250 then overwrote WS-INFO-MSG with the change prompt before 3300 ran; NO-CHANGES-DETECTED at :3011 is false because WS-RETURN-MSG holds the area-code message; the two filter arms at :3013-3014 are false; and every arm from :3017 to :3119 is false because those flags are ISVALID. The first true arm is WHEN FLG-STATE-NOT-OK at :3121, which MOVEs -1 TO ACSSTTEL - reached before the phone arms at :3138-3156. So the two chains disagree on purpose: 1260 wins the message and 1280 wins the cursor. COBOL positions the cursor by moving -1 into a symbolic-map length item, which is why the expectation names ACSSTTEL rather than a payload field. STATELESSNESS (rule R6, gate G37). No server-side session exists and none is needed. Inbound the payload carries the 1033-byte EIBCALEN, the AID, the sixteen CARDDEMO-COMMAREA fields and the 43 received map items; outbound it carries the same sixteen navigation fields, unchanged, because nothing on this path writes a CDEMO- item - only the PF03 arm at :944-950 does that - plus nextProgram COACTUPC, nextMapset COACTUP and nextMap CACTUPA from :1031-1033 and 3400-SEND-SCREEN :3591-3592, and termination RETURN_TRANSID from :1015-1018 rather than XCTL, the program's only XCTL being in the PF03 arm at :956-959. ONE MODELLING LIMIT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN WORKED AROUND: the inbound 873-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA - ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION 'S' and the ACUP-OLD-DETAILS snapshot - cannot be expressed in screenRequest.commarea, whose keys must be CDEMO- or WS- names, because its items are ACUP- prefixed. It is therefore stated above in prose and is fully determined by the four seeded rows plus 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA, which is what makes this case reproducible as case04's successor turn. NOTHING IS READ, NOTHING IS WRITTEN, AND BOTH ARE POSITIVE ASSERTIONS. expectedWrites is empty: COACTUPC's only write verbs are the read-for-update and REWRITE pairs inside 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING :3888-4105, which only the PF05 confirmation arm at :2602-2605 reaches. Each of the four seeded rows is pinned unchanged on the final-state channel, field by field for the cross-reference, account and customer and as a whole 150-byte image for the card, so a stray write would fail on both the field names and the total width. The seed is the same slice case04 uses and every row of it is a measured fact: acctdata.txt row 0 and custdata.txt row 0 are account 00000000001 and customer 000000001, and cardxref.txt row 48 and carddata.txt row 48 are that account's cross-reference and card. cardxref.txt is seeded RAW at 36 bytes and is NOT pre-padded - CVACT03Y declares 50 and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER X(14) - so the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation supplies the fourteen spaces once, at seed time, and the final-state image is asserted at the copybook's 50 (gate G16, risk R-F). RETURN CODE 0: the identifier RETURN-CODE does not occur anywhere in COACTUPC's 4,236 lines, because it is pseudo-conversational and ends at EXEC CICS RETURN. THE MESSAGE CHANNEL IS SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 AND THE CHOICE IS DELIBERATE. COACTUPC contains zero DISPLAY statements, so it emits no console line at all; what it produces is the 78-byte ERRMSGO the symbolic map declares at COACTUP.CPY:650, which is exactly what that channel names and fixes the width of. The one expected message is therefore byte-identical to the ERRMSGO pinned in the send, and the two are cross-checks on each other rather than two spellings of one guess. GATES. G15 and G16 by construction. G18 - the diff count must be zero across every field of every one of the 54 screen items, all 108 attribute items, the cursor, the navigation image and the four record images. G30 - the forward-jump stage structure of 1260 and the source WHEN order of the EVALUATEs at :921, :2563, :2710, :2957 and :3009, three of which are decided here by arms that are not the first. G37 and G38 as set out above. G51 - unitKind CONTROLLER_POJO: account.AccountUpdateController is constructed directly with a real account.AreaCodeLookup and fixture-backed repositories and its handler called as a plain method, with no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path. TWO GATES ARE NOT APPLICABLE AND ARE RECORDED AS SUCH RATHER THAN SILENTLY SKIPPED. G32 does not apply: COACTUPC's GO TOs all target an -EXIT label, COMMON-RETURN or a forward stage - the four in 1260 among them - and CBSTM03A is the only program in this migration whose GO TOs form implicit loops. G35 does not apply: CALL 'CEE3ABD' occurs zero times in COACTUPC, all nine sites being in batch programs, and the EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999') in ABEND-ROUTINE :4203-4226 is unreachable on a path that performs no file operation at all. PROVENANCE (practice B12). Every expected value above was derived STATICALLY. Set membership was re-derived by reading app/cpy/CSLKPCDY.cpy:521-930 for the phone codes and :1073-1313 for the state-and-zip combinations, and the two phone numbers were obtained by DECODING app/data/ASCII/custdata.txt at CVCUS01Y's own offsets - bytes 250-264 and 265-279 of the 500-byte record - with the account, cross-reference and card values decoded the same way from acctdata.txt, cardxref.txt and carddata.txt against CVACT01Y 300, CVACT03Y 50 and CVACT02Y 150. The control flow was read from app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:82-116, :168-200, :315-352, :411-416, :463-500, :640-849, :859-1020, :1025-1224, :1279-1428, :1429-1449, :1452-1476, :1529-1556, :1592-1676, :1681-1780, :1824-1953, :2109-2223, :2225-2429, :2431-2560, :2562-2643, :2649-2726, :2870-2985, :2986-3167, :3186-3437 and :3566-3605, from app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy:18-372 and CSUTLDWY.cpy:4-86 for the date edits, and from app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy:17-27 for the highlight rule, with the widths cross-checked against the xxxI, xxxO and xxxL PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions and INITIAL text of app/bms/COACTUP.bms, and the commarea layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy. It was NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository - and this static derivation is the recorded substitute for an execution baseline, escalated as risk R-A rather than silently absorbed. AUTHORING NOTES. No user-specified rule governs this fixture; review_rules returns exactly 'No user rules provided', so enterprise best practice governs and none has been invented. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:15:59, this source revision's own timestamp, so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are fixed literals that no wall clock can reach (practice B7); the charset is named US-ASCII explicitly and is never the platform default (practice B8); every width comes from a PICTURE clause rather than from a count of the characters that happen to be present (practice B11); and this case's distinct subject is the phone area-code lookup - the state-code and state-plus-zip lookups of the same copybook belong to case12, and appear here only as the unavoidable consequence the fixture forces (practice B1). Finally, as case04 already records, COACTUPCParityTest currently declares its twenty scenarios in Java rather than loading them from this directory and allocates its own case11 to a different scenario; the divergence in NUMBERING is recorded here rather than resolved by inventing a different scenario, because the scenario itself - the 410-code area-code lookup hit once and missed once in a single turn - is what this case is specified to pin.

OBSERVATION SCOPE, STATED SO IT CANNOT BE MISREAD AS AN OMISSION. COACTUPC contains no DISPLAY verb - no CICS program does - so this case declares no DISPLAY_LINE and no SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 message. WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :479 leaves the program through MOVE WS-RETURN-MSG TO ERRMSGO OF CACTUPAO at :2981 followed by EXEC CICS SEND MAP, and ERRMSGO is pinned byte for byte inside expectedResponse.sends at its declared PIC X(78) width. Declaring it a second time on a message channel would make one difference report as two and would invent an emission the program does not perform. The eighty-byte WS-DATE-VALIDATION-RESULT of each CALL 'CSUTLDTC' (app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy:293 into app/cpy/CSUTLDWY.cpy:60-85) IS declared, on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel and in call order, because nothing in the response exposes it and its count is itself an assertion about how far the edit chain ran.

THE CARRIED AREA, AND WHY IT IS DECLARED IN FULL. DFHCOMMAREA carries CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA together and :890-892 moves the second in whole, so the case declares all 873 bytes the copybook at :652-849 defines: ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION X(1), then ACUP-OLD-DETAILS and ACUP-NEW-DETAILS at 436 bytes each. The action is 'S' - 88 ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS at :659 - which is the state 3202-SHOW-ORIGINAL-VALUES leaves after a successful fetch and the only state in which 1100-RECEIVE-MAP does NOT return early at :1060-1062 and 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS therefore edits all forty-three writable items. ACUP-OLD-DETAILS is the snapshot 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA built from the seeded ACCTDAT and CUSTDAT rows, with the three account dates and the date of birth carried at PIC X(08) rather than the record's PIC X(10) because the group drops the separators. ACUP-NEW-DETAILS is declared at LOW-VALUES throughout, which is what INITIALIZE ACUP-NEW-DETAILS at :1047 leaves before the re-staging: whatever a warm turn arrived carrying is discarded there, so declaring anything else would describe a state the program overwrites before reading.
